confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge, not checked against live listings or menus. Argentina has high and volatile inflation, so prices in USD can shift quickly and restaurant and hotel anchors are less reliable than the hostel anchors. Accommodation anchors assume July winter-holiday demand with taxes included. FX provenance is weak: the 0.6947 USD per AUD value for 2026-10-16 comes from a third-party site that says it reproduces RBA data. I did not open rba.gov.au, and the source_url is the RBA page where the figure is published, not one I verified. Drink anchors use the beer price as the local reference, since direct knowledge of cocktail and wine prices is weaker.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional basis: major Latin American capitals with strong tourist demand (for example Santiago, Montevideo and Lima), adjusted for Argentina's currency volatility and its price levels for visitors in recent years. No single city was used as a direct comparator.
